Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. a16z-northwood-space:ashbyhq:c061aa41-3e.description: Northwood is on a mission to transform connectivity between Earth and space. Northwood’s global ground network ensures that missions ranging from national security, to global connectivity, to disaster response can unlock their full potential and operate every day without fail.
